key_insight: Robot-mounted vision and deep learning offer a path toward automated post-weld inspection through defect detection, 3D weld measurement, and multimodal diagnosis.
engineering_relevance: These approaches could reduce reliance on manual judgment and support online quality feedback in robotic welding production lines.
method: Reviews non-destructive and destructive post-weld inspection techniques.
Organizes vision processing into preprocessing, defect recognition and segmentation, and quality diagnosis.
Compares CNN, YOLO, U-Net, and DETR approaches across inspection tasks and application scenarios.
evidence_signal: The abstract describes a systematic technology review but reports no datasets, quantitative benchmarks, or experimental validation.
watch_item: Industrial interference may affect inspection reliability, and robust online closed-loop deployment remains an engineering challenge.
paper_title: A Review of Post-weld Inspection Technology
